title: ED-23 canary reference contract (cheese-9056)
description: Researcher-authored after the first real production certification run (ED-23). Not a §4 artifact schema and not a job config schema -- deliberately kept outside schemas/ so it is never swept into the A1-A12 or job-config schema inventories (test_schema_validate.py). Validated directly via interplab.core._schema_registry.validate.

feature_certificate_hash.description: The real feature_certificate that established expected_metrics -- provenance, not something the comparator invents.

pinned_slice.description: Provenance pointer to the corpus slice the pinned characterization sample was drawn from.

expected_metrics.description: Flat dotted-path -> numeric value, e.g. 'sensitivity.word_absent_fire_rate'. Must cover exactly the same paths as tolerances (checked in code, not schema).

tolerances.description: Same dotted paths as expected_metrics; absolute tolerance per metric.
